The user wants to mark compilation errors from the bottom console with a red line in the left margin of the editor at the exact line of the error.

T1 found: `push active file diagnostics from cache`, `apply lsp diagnostics to panel`, `rebuild diagnostics by line if changed`, `line gutter marker`, `line diagnostic marker from map`, `rebuild diagnostics by line`. This is the mechanism for marking errors in the editor margin (LSP diagnostics).
T2 found: `buffer text`, `make problem row element`. This is about reading errors from the console to mark them in the editor, but it seems to be about the console's own problem rows, not the editor margin.
T3 found: `terminal row link` in `console panel` invokes `find compiler location` in `compiler location` which parses GCC/MSVC styles and returns a `Compiler Location Match` (path, line, column). This object is used for navigation links, NOT sent directly to the LSP diagnostics system, but it IS the extraction of compilation errors from the console.

The gap is: T3 extracts the error location (`Compiler Location Match`), but it's used for navigation links. T1 shows how LSP diagnostics are applied to
